# playzy.me — Smart, Playful Tech & AI Research

> Evidence-based reviews, deep-dive benchmarks, and how-to guides on AI tools, SaaS products, productivity workflows, and digital monetization.

## About playzy.me
playzy.me is an independent software research publication. We specialize in empirical evaluations, hands-on SWE-bench coding model evaluations, hardware/cloud cost breakdowns, and workflow optimizations. All reviews undergo a minimum 30-day testing window by verified software engineers.

## Content Pillars & Key Resource Links

### 1. AI Tool Reviews & Comparisons
- [Claude 3.5 Sonnet vs GPT-4o Developer Benchmark](https://playzy.me/blog/claude-3-5-sonnet-vs-gpt-4o-developer-benchmark): Standardized coding, output speed, and architectural evaluation of Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet vs OpenAI's GPT-4o.
- [Best AI Coding Assistants: Cursor, GitHub Copilot & Supermaven](https://playzy.me/blog/best-ai-coding-assistants-cursor-copilot-supermaven): Auto-complete latency, codebase context indexing, and multi-file editing tests.
- [Midjourney v6 vs Flux.1 Review](https://playzy.me/blog/midjourney-v6-vs-flux-1-ai-image-generation-review): Typography rendering, prompt adherence, and open-weights API comparison.

### 2. Software & SaaS Deep Dives
- [Notion vs Obsidian Knowledge OS](https://playzy.me/blog/notion-vs-obsidian-knowledge-os-comparison): Relational cloud databases vs local-first plain-text Markdown PKM systems.
- [Linear vs Jira for Engineering Teams](https://playzy.me/blog/linear-vs-jira-modern-dev-team-issue-tracking): Keyboard-first client sync engine vs enterprise workflow issue tracking.
- [Raycast Masterclass](https://playzy.me/blog/raycast-masterclass-15-workflows-replacing-10-apps): Replaced 10 standalone macOS background utilities to eliminate system bloat.

### 3. Digital Money-Making (Legitimate Monetization)
- [How to Build & Monetize a Micro-SaaS (Zero to $1k MRR)](https://playzy.me/blog/build-monetize-micro-saas-ai-zero-to-1k-mrr): Solo developer blueprint leveraging Next.js, Lemon Squeezy, Supabase, and Cursor.
- [Freelance AI Consulting (Pricing, Pitching & Deliverables)](https://playzy.me/blog/freelance-ai-consulting-pricing-pitching-deliverables): Enterprise RAG search, lead triage, and value-based fixed project pricing.
- [Gumroad vs Lemon Squeezy vs Shopify](https://playzy.me/blog/gumroad-vs-lemon-squeezy-vs-shopify-digital-products): Merchant of Record (MoR) tax compliance and transaction fee breakdown.

### 4. Productivity & Workflow Guides
- [The 80/20 Automation Stack](https://playzy.me/blog/80-20-automation-stack-zapier-make-python): Combining Make.com visual routers with serverless Python scripts to cut SaaS costs by 80%.
- [Deep Work Zero-Notification Setup](https://playzy.me/blog/deep-work-zero-notification-setup-guide): Async team communication agreements and cognitive focus protection.

### 5. Industry News & Trend Explainers
- [The Rise of Agentic AI Workflows](https://playzy.me/blog/agentic-ai-workflows-impact-on-knowledge-workers): Shift from single-turn chat prompts to multi-step autonomous reflection loops.
- [Open-Source AI Models vs Proprietary APIs](https://playzy.me/blog/open-source-ai-vs-proprietary-apis-cost-privacy): Cost comparison of Llama 3.3 / DeepSeek self-hosting vs OpenAI / Anthropic cloud APIs.
